name: Game Studio & Interactive Web Adaptive OST Pack
description: 6 adaptive 4-stem game soundtracks targeting UE5, Unity 6, Godot 4, Mobile Game, 1st Grade Learning, My Planetarium, and AAC.

tracks.title: Shadow Blade: Dojo Resonance
tracks.cueNotes: Vertical stem mix: Exploration = instruments; Combat = instruments + bass + drums; Climax = all 4 stems.
tracks.prompt: High-impact martial arts fighting game soundtrack at 136 BPM in D minor. Virtuosic Tsugaru shamisen riffs, deep taiko and modern industrial breakbeat drums, sub-heavy distorted synth bass, soaring cinematic shakuhachi accents. Steady grid, clean 4-stem separation, seamless loopable 16-bar structure.
tracks.lyrics:
[Instrumental]
Adaptive combat cue for Shadow Blade UE5.

tracks.title: Paper Ronin Expedition
tracks.cueNotes: Crossfade drums + bass in smoothly when turn-based encounter starts in PaperMario_Expedition33_Unity.
tracks.prompt: Charming paper-craft tactical RPG overworld-to-battle soundtrack at 118 BPM in G major. Crisp acoustic nylon guitar, playful woodwind flute and accordion melodies, bouncy pizzicato upright bass, crisp snare and tambourine percussion layer. Instrumental, clean stem layers, seamless loop.

tracks.title: Grandmaster Gambit (Chess Clash)
tracks.cueNotes: Layer drums + bass stems when player clock drops under 30 seconds or check tension spikes.
tracks.prompt: Sleek tactical board-game soundtrack at 104 BPM in C minor. Crisp wooden marimba arpeggios, upright plucked double bass, brushed jazz kit shifting into sharp rhythmic rimshots, muted brass swells for checkmate tension. Instrumental, steady 104 BPM grid, seamless loop.

tracks.title: Shattered Pagoda Duel
tracks.cueNotes: Stage 1 exploration uses instruments + wind pads; duel phase fades in bass + heavy combat percussion.
tracks.prompt: Dramatic eastern duel soundtrack at 128 BPM in E minor. Expressive shakuhachi bamboo flute and koto plucks over dark brooding analog synth bass and rapid martial combat drums. Clean 4-stem separation for adaptive boss phases, seamless loop.

tracks.title: Turbo Type Neon Circuit
tracks.cueNotes: Streak-reactive audio: 0-10 streak = instruments; 10-25 = +bass; 25+ = +drums; turbo fever = all 4 stems.
tracks.prompt: Joyful high-speed arcade racing synthwave track at 142 BPM in A major. Sparkling 16-bit chiptune brass leads, bouncy octave synthwave bassline, punchy crisp arcade drum machine, uplifting key-change feel without jarring dissonances. Family-friendly, steady BPM grid, seamless loop.

tracks.title: Celestial Drift (Deep Observatory)
tracks.cueNotes: Normalized to -18 LUFS for comfortable long-duration listening inside My Planetarium WebGL and AAC.
tracks.prompt: Expansive cosmic observatory ambient music at 72 BPM in F major. Warm analog Juno and Prophet space pads, delicate glass bell arpeggios, deep resonant sub drone, zero harsh percussion or jarring spikes. Peaceful stargazing atmosphere, seamless loop.
tracks.lyrics:
[Instrumental]
Ambient observatory soundscape for My Planetarium & AAC.
